reasoning_content: Now let's try to install Android SDK cmdline tools. This is the documented requirement. Download from dl.google.com.

action.command: mkdir -p /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && cd /tmp && curl -sSL -o cmdtools.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip && ls -la cmdtools.zip && unzip -q cmdtools.zip -d /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && mv /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest && ls /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "mkdir -p /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && cd /tmp && curl -sSL -o cmdtools.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip && ls -la cmdtools.zip && unzip -q cmdtools.zip -d /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && mv /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest && ls /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Download and install Android cmdline-tools"}
